description: Fetches dictionary entries from indochine.uqam.ca, a scholarly historical dictionary on the Indochina War (1945-1956) maintained by UQAM.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_entry: Fetches a specific dictionary entry by URL; requires url parameter; 参数: url, article_id, lang; 必填: 无

url.description: Full URL to the dictionary entry (e.g., https://indochine.uqam.ca/en/historical-dictionary/320-coup-de-force-of-9-march-1945.html). Required for get_entry.

article_id.description: Numeric article ID from URL path (e.g., 320). Cannot be used alone; full URL required.

lang.description: Language code - "fr" for French (le-dictionnaire) or "en" for English (historical-dictionary). Auto-detected from URL if not specified.
